subject: Nanotechnology
title: Gravity Becomes Irrelevant
description: A short lesson to help you apply Gravity Becomes Irrelevant.

hook.text: Drop a bowling ball and a nanoparticle — the ball thuds while the nanoparticle floats forever.

buildup.text: Gravity scales with mass, which drops as the cube of size — shrink 1000x and gravity weakens a billionfold.

discovery.text: Brownian motion, electrostatics, and van der Waals forces completely overpower gravity at nanoscale.

twist.text: Nanoparticles never settle — centrifuges at 50,000 RPM are needed to pull them down.

climax.text: Nano engineers design without gravity — their world is ruled by surface forces and thermal energy.

punchline.text: Gravity is a giant's problem — nanoparticles ignore it.

quiz.question: Why is gravity negligible at the nanoscale?
options: Mass shrinks so dramatically that other forces dominate
Air resistance cancels gravity for tiny objects
